app_name: Indian Army Predictive Logistics & Forward Supply Chain (SIH 2026 PS26251)
context: Dashboard & Decision-Support Platform with Predictive Forward Logistics Digital Twin
emotional_tone: Authoritative, High-Precision Tactical, Calm Command Center, Reliable

colors.archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO & TACTICAL MILITARY COMMAND

layout_strategy.grid_mode: High Density Dashboard & Bento Tactical Grid

image_urls.description: Military supply depot facility with storage structures
Tactical control room with multi-monitor command setups

components: Logistics Intelligence Control Tower (4-question command center overview)
Tactical Geographic Network Map (Leaflet / interactive nodes & supply routes)
Digital Twin Node & Route Details Inspector
Inventory & Consumption Engine (Ammo, Rations, Fuel, Spares)
Baseline & Scikit-Learn ML Demand Forecast (MAE/RMSE evaluation)
Transparent Weighted Risk Scoring & Shortage Prediction
Disruption & What-If Simulation Engine (Route block, weather, surge)
Secure Demo Authentication with Role-Aware Switcher (Planner / Commander / Admin / Skip Auth)

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_convention: kebab-case role-based testid attributes on all interactive elements
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: WCAG AA compliant high contrast dark mode with tactical amber and emerald status badges
